name: Champion (Fighter Subclass - 2024)
description: A Champion focuses on the development of martial prowess in a relentless pursuit of victory, combining rigorous training with physical excellence.
source: D&D Beyond Basic Rules 2024 - Fighter Class

3.name: Improved Critical
3.description: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

3.name: Remarkable Athlete
3.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks. Immediately after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

7.name: Additional Fighting Style
7.description: You gain another Fighting Style feat of your choice.

10.name: Heroic Warrior
10.description: During combat, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration whenever you start your turn without it.

15.name: Superior Critical
15.description: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20 on the d20.

18.name: Survivor
18.description: You attain the pinnacle of resilience. Benefits: Defy Death (Advantage on Death Saves; roll 18-20 on Death Save counts as 20). Heroic Rally (At start of turn, regain HP = 5 + Con mod if Bloodied and have at least 1 HP).
